## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-body);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-manrope);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- |
